Short answer: Find out whether the failure is the internet line, the router or access point, local coverage, or one device. Test one layer at a time.

What this means for your business

The Wi-Fi symbol only proves a device sees a wireless network. It does not prove the router reaches the internet or that the service your POS needs is available.

What to watch

  • Every device fails at once versus only one device.
  • Wired service works while Wi-Fi fails.
  • Failures cluster in one room or at one busy time.
  • The POS shows a provider-specific service or firewall error.

Do this next

  1. Record the time, devices, location, and exact error.
  2. Check the internet provider and critical service status.
  3. Test one wired device and one nearby wireless device.
  4. Reboot only the identified layer, then document what changed.
